method.canonical_public_entries: Nodes with public_visibility=public whose id is not redirected by canonical_redirects, using the same rule as the readable atlas.
method.developed_profiles: Distinct profile.node_id values resolving to those canonical public entries; publication_level=profile is counted separately.
method.literal_first_pass_entries: Canonical public nodes containing the exact lower-case substring 'first-pass entry' in the joined string values of the node record. This is a literal placeholder-wording count, not an assessment of every entry's quality.
method.first_pass_person_review_records: Canonical public person nodes whose review_status contains first_pass. This is a separate bibliographic status count.
method.graph_metrics: The existing apply_iteration_09.graph_metrics function resolves public endpoints and separates substantive relations from classification, evidence, documentary, and unresolved legacy lines. It does not deduce new relationships.
method.limits: Dataset counts do not establish source reading, intellectual importance, scholarly agreement, human acceptance, or completion of the registered research programmes.
